text:
Hi Gray Matter team — I’m Noor Halden, a developer with 6 years of experience building AI and machine learning solutions.

I’d love to join your 5-day sprint as a full-stack developer. Your focus on a Simple, Lovable, and Complete GenAI SaaS product is exactly the kind of fast-paced, collaborative work I enjoy. I’m comfortable moving quickly from concept to implementation while keeping the product practical, clear, and user-focused.

One project I can point to is a contract clause search assistant for a legal client. I built it with Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. The system answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used, which helped make the results trustworthy and easy to verify. It achieved a faithfulness score of 0.91 on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

That project reflects the kind of work I’d bring to your sprint: building useful AI products that combine strong retrieval, reliable responses, and a clean user experience. I’m comfortable working across the stack and collaborating closely with a founder and team to quickly test ideas, refine the product direction, and ship something meaningful in a short timeframe.

My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I can contribute both to the AI layer and to the product implementation, helping move from brainstorming to a working prototype efficiently.

I’d be excited to help Gray Matter turn a strong concept into a polished GenAI SaaS product over the 5-day sprint.
